The '''Pa'hir'al system''' was a part of [[Urce sector/Legends|Urce Space]],<ref name="EAOC" /> which was located in the [[Lesser Plooriod Cluster/Legends|Lesser Plooriod Cluster]]<ref name="LPC" /> and constituted a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[City/Legends|settlement]] known as [[Pa'hir'al City]], in which the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] operative [[Tirranna]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] was captured by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="AIR" /> around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', which establishes that [[Tirranna]] was captured in [[Pa'hir'al City]] "approximately two and a half [[Standard year/Legends|years]]" prior to its setting, represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one year before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Pa'hir'al system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-7.<ref name="TEA" />
